entities.name: Dominika Šalková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dominika Šalková is a Czech tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 129, achieved on 29 July 2024, by the WTA. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of No. 138, achieved on 16 February 2026.
